pit_label_rule: PIT_SAFE is reserved for a run that can emit all applicable PIT fields and establish source-vintage availability. The committed empirical engines enforce strict historical cutoffs, but the adjusted-close vendor vintage and historical universe/governance vintages are not independently verified; those paths are labelled PIT_MECHANICS_ENFORCED_DATA_VINTAGE_UNVERIFIED.

mode_audit.Financial purpose: Select and validate a time-varying risky-sleeve exposure policy for SPY against a cash sleeve.
mode_audit.Entry point: runCampaign(campaign, rows, root, options); CLI in research/capital/cli.ts
mode_audit.Exact execution command: From artifacts/api-server: ./node_modules/.bin/esbuild ../../research/capital/engine.test.ts ../../research/capital/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --alias:@workspace/db=./src/lib/calculator.a1.db-shim.ts --outdir=dist/cl03; then from repository root: node artifacts/api-server/dist/cl03/cli.js configs/capital-research/acceptance-traditional.json --dry-run && node artifacts/api-server/dist/cl03/cli.js configs/capital-research/acceptance-traditional.json --run
User-configurable parameters: 0/5 or other declared nonnegative transaction-cost scenarios
mode_audit.Data source: Committed adjusted-close snapshot reports/cl02/adjusted-closes.csv; 4,023 rows, 22 tickers, 2010-10-01 through 2026-09-30; operated instrument SPY.
mode_audit.Empirical / synthetic: EMPIRICAL for committed acceptance configs; separate QA fixtures are synthetic.
mode_audit.PIT safe?: PIT_MECHANICS_ENFORCED_DATA_VINTAGE_UNVERIFIED: fit cutoffs, strict previous-close information and next-close execution pass; source vendor/vintage and historical universe membership are not independently verified.
mode_audit.Costs supported?: Yes: explicit bps on actual absolute traded notional; committed acceptance contains 0 and 5 bps, zero slippage.
Validation methods supported?: fold selection frozen before outer OOS
mode_audit.Exact blocker: No blocker for the narrow committed traditional/nested path. Limits: only current_regime/cash_band/constant real families, benchmark output unsupported, DSR NOT_IMPLEMENTED, data-vintage PIT unverified, independent fold sleeves rather than one continuous account.

mode_audit.Financial purpose: Allocate risky-sleeve capital across assets, then keep risky-sleeve weights separate from ExposureController final NAV weights.
mode_audit.Entry point: allocateAssets(input); research/allocation runCampaign(campaign, data, root, options)
mode_audit.Exact execution command: Use the committed AL-07 bundle/CLI: node artifacts/api-server/dist/al07/cli.mjs reports/al07/configs/AL07_REAL_TRADITIONAL_EXPANDING.json --DRY_RUN, then the same command with --EXECUTE (after building the documented research/allocation entries with the repository esbuild binary).
mode_audit.Data source: CL-02 committed prices plus committed AL-03 dated risk snapshots; empirical acceptance has SPY/XLC/XLK/XLV eligible history and a wider fixed snapshot provenance.
mode_audit.Empirical / synthetic: EMPIRICAL for EQUAL_WEIGHT, MIN_VARIANCE and ERC; synthetic tests cover all five mechanical objectives.
mode_audit.PIT safe?: PIT_MECHANICS_ENFORCED_DATA_VINTAGE_UNVERIFIED; native artifacts are validated before publication-envelope use and future observations are excluded, but contemporaneous vendor/universe vintages are not authenticated.
mode_audit.Costs supported?: Yes in AL-07 books: 0/5 bps or explicit campaign scenarios on actual instrument notional; strategy internal NET costs are not recharged.
Validation methods supported?: raw risky sleeve and beta-normalized track
mode_audit.Exact blocker: MEAN_VARIANCE and MAX_SHARPE are BLOCKED_MISSING_PIT_EXPECTED_RETURNS in the empirical campaign; only EQUAL_WEIGHT, MIN_VARIANCE and ERC are empirically executable.

mode_audit.Financial purpose: Map externally supplied factor targets and factor-risk artifacts into constrained risky-sleeve asset weights.
mode_audit.Explicit defaults: No empirical defaults; required factor artifacts cannot be silently inferred. Synthetic fixture policies are explicit fixture values.
mode_audit.Data source: Committed synthetic fixtures only. CL-02 prices and feature definitions are not canonical factor target/loading/risk histories.
mode_audit.PIT safe?: Synthetic PIT selector mechanics pass; empirical PIT cannot be established without dated canonical artifacts.
mode_audit.Costs supported?: No standalone execution ledger/cost model; allocator weights feed a later execution layer.
mode_audit.Exact blocker: BLOCKED_MISSING_CANONICAL_FACTOR_ARTIFACTS: no dated target, loading, Phi, D and tracking bundle for every historical decision.

mode_audit.Financial purpose: Allocate among distinct strategy instances, map strategy capital through dated position maps, and retain internal residual capital separately from global cash.
Required inputs: expected returns/covariance where objective consumes them
mode_audit.Explicit defaults: No historical backfill/default for missing maps, histories or governance; supplied synthetic fixture values are explicit.
mode_audit.Data source: Synthetic certification fixtures. Available legacy files are incomplete and two preparation bundles are Git LFS pointers rather than payloads.
mode_audit.PIT safe?: Synthetic temporal selection is enforced; empirical PIT is blocked by absent dated histories/maps/availability metadata.
mode_audit.Costs supported?: Strategy return histories must already be NET; master costs require actual instrument notionals and are not invented.
mode_audit.Exact blocker: BLOCKED_MISSING_CANONICAL_ALPHA_STREAM_ARTIFACTS / BLOCKED_MISSING_STRATEGY_HISTORY: complete NET histories, dated maps, versioned definitions, risk bundles and availability metadata are absent.

mode_audit.Financial purpose: Observe coverage, dispersion, factor concentration and ranking stability without altering allocation.

mode_audit.PIT safe?: Synthetic cutoff/publication mechanics pass; no empirical legacy history is available.
mode_audit.Costs supported?: Not applicable; observer does not execute trades.
mode_audit.Exact blocker: BLOCKED_MISSING_LEGACY_NODE3_SOURCE and missing actual historical signal/ranking publication stream.
